In Rookgaard, {npc:Al Dee} will only swap a {item:Pick} for a good-quality {item:Small Axe}. Find a Small Axe in one of the island's many caves (or from a {creature:Goblin}) and take it to Al Dee to get your pick.

It seems a traveller died by choosing the wrong path, running into some filthy beasts, instead of crossing the poisonous gas and finding the treasure guarded by black magic. — from a report found long ago (Katana Quest cave).
Doesn't need Premium (there are Free paths and Premium-only paths).

Choose **one** of the paths below to get the {item:Small Axe}. The first three are Premium only.
The {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} are too strong for Rookgaard and can't be pushed: don't get cornered.
There are six ways to get the {item:Small Axe}. You only need to do one.

In the Premium area, at the far **southwest**, past the swamps, there is a hole covered by a tree. Open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down. There is only one path. At the bottom there are two coffins guarded by two {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}: the **right** coffin has a {item:Small Axe}. It can even be done at level 1. **To leave:** go back the same way (there is only one) and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you went down to return to the surface.
The two coffins at the bottom of the Skeleton Cave (the one on the right has the Small Axe)
Expect about 2 {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and 3 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} in the cave.
{creature:Goblin|Goblins} sometimes drop {item:Small Axe|Small Axes}. Kill them until you get one.
In the main cave of the Rookgaard Premium area there are several places where {item:Small Axe|Small Axes} appear.

Take the **north** exit of the village and go **northeast** to a {item:Loose Stone Pile}. Open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down. Kill the {creature:Poison Spider} and the {creature:Spider|Spiders} and follow the cave to a staircase down. Go down, kill the 3 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and follow the cave **east** to a rope hole. Use the {item:Rope}, go up and head **north**. Search the dead human: it has a {item:Small Axe} (one per floor reset). **To leave:** go back the same way: go down the hole you climbed up with the rope, go back **west** to the staircase and go up, and finally use the {item:Rope} on the Loose Stone Pile hole to return to the surface. From there, return to the village through the north exit.

There are {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} here: they are too strong for Rookgaard and can't be pushed. Walk around the cave to lead them away (they are slow) or run straight to the body. Killing them is not recommended. If you get cornered, you will hardly survive.
This is also the path of the {wiki:Katana Quest}, which you can do at the same time.
Search the human's body to find a Small Axe
Katana Quest cave entrance (graves to the northeast)

Take the **north** exit of the village, go **north** and go down the underground stairway. Go **north** and then **east** to a staircase down. Go down, walk **north** and, when the path splits, go **west**. Go down at the first staircase you find. Go **west**, kill the {creature:Orc|Orcs} in the big room and search the **south** extension of the cave: there are 2 {item:Box|boxes} and a {item:Chest|chest}. The **east** box has a {item:Small Axe} and 4 {item:Arrow|Arrows} after each floor reset. **To leave:** go back the same way and go up the stairs to the stairway of the main cave, north of the village.
Open the box to find a Small Axe and 4 Arrows
Stairway of the main Rookgaard cave

Take the **north** exit, go **north** and go down the stairway. Go **north** and then **east** to a staircase down. Go down, walk **north** and, at the fork, go **northeast**; at the next fork go **northwest** to another staircase down. Go down and walk **north** to the next staircase (full of {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and a few {creature:Orc|Orcs}). Go down again and clear the room: there are 2 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} with lots of orcs and wolves. In the **southeast** part of the room, right next to the staircase down, look behind a big stone: there is a {item:Small Axe} hidden there. **To leave:** go back the same way, going up the stairs floor by floor to the stairway of the main cave, north of the village (see also the {wiki:Minotaur Hell Quest|Minotaur Hell Quest}).
The {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} are dangerous for very low levels.
Look behind the stone: there is a Small Axe hidden

2. Exchanging the Small Axe for the Pick
Go back to the village of Rookgaard and take the {item:Small Axe} to {npc:Al Dee}'s shop. Say {key:hi}, {key:pick} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Pick}.
Also known as the Small Axe Quest.
